title: Canonical Action Envelope
description: The protocol-neutral representation of an agent's request paired with trusted attributes.

principal.description: Authenticated identity of the user or system initiating the session.

agent.description: Identity of the agent framework or specific autonomous loop.

delegation.description: Chain of trust and permissions delegated to the agent.

capability.description: Authoritative identity and properties of the tool being requested, derived from the trusted catalog.

resource.description: Target resource attributes if the action targets a specific entity (e.g., file, DB row).

arguments.description: The normalized, agent-provided payload for the tool execution.

input_provenance.description: Lineage identifiers tracking the sources of data influencing the arguments.

destination.description: Trusted attributes about the network or system receiving the action.

session.description: Lineage session identifiers for stateful consequence tracking.

manifest_digest.description: SHA-256 hash of the trusted tool manifest to prevent TOCTOU changes.

policy_version.description: The version of the security policy active when the envelope was created.

protocol_evidence.description: Raw context extracted from the transport layer (e.g., HTTP headers, gRPC metadata) used by the binder.
